tools.name: import_auction
tools.description: Read CSV or labeled field text into item records. No facts are inferred. Extra columns are skipped and named. Malformed rows are refused. Input is not retained.

tools.name: check_auction
tools.description: Check missing facts, duplicate IDs and certificates, expiry, donor contacts, lot numbers and package values. Returns row-linked errors and warnings. Nothing is saved.

tools.name: make_auction_file
tools.description: Return one file as an embedded resource. Kinds: catalog (folded booklet), bids, cards and tally are PDFs. items, thanks and checks (the list of problems) are CSVs. Terms are printed as supplied. Errors block files. Up to 15 items free; a paid code is bound to one auction, up to 150 items.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "make_auction_file" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
